title: Recognize signed-in accounts in generated APEX menus
changes: Runtime checks use the account menu emitted by the native APEX template.
Wrong, missing or ambiguous account labels still stop verification.
Earlier failed checks stay retained; no conversion or import is replayed.
limitations: Experimental preview with bounded Forms-to-native-APEX conversion coverage.
APEX generated, technical checks passed and business acceptance remain separate.
Release notes describe software changes, not proof of a successful conversion.
